title: Italian defense figure in Sorensen story identified as Frank Carlucci

tellings.quote: I'm friends with a couple of really good researchers who think that the Italian guy is Frank Carluchi.

plain: Some researchers think the unnamed Italian defense figure in a story told by a man named Sorensen, set in Palmdale, California, in 1988, was really the defense official Frank Carlucci. Michels says this himself. He credits a couple of researcher friends whom he calls very good but does not name, and he also brings up the Carlyle Group in the conversation. If they are right, a known senior figure was part of the scene Sorensen describes.
